summary: Fix correctly extends call_command's required-argument passthrough to also cover options belonging to a required mutually exclusive group, matching the root cause in the issue. Approach mirrors existing style in the same function (walking parser._actions/private argparse internals), is minimal, and doesn't alter behavior for non-group required arguments.

issues.description: Relies on argparse private attribute parser._mutually_exclusive_groups/_group_actions, but this is consistent with the surrounding code's existing use of opt._long_opts-style private argparse internals in the same function.
